# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.0.1

- Adds the Windows x64 installer with the stem model included and signed in-app updates.
- Corrects DirectML stem output on supported Windows GPUs and releases the GPU model before retrying failed inference on CPU.
- Cancels stem preparation while the model is loading or processing its first chunk.
- Keeps the latest macOS downloads and updates available independently of Windows releases.
- Introduces the refreshed Aqua interface on Mac and Windows, with Light, Dark and System appearance settings.
- Makes the USB preparation instructions easy to reopen and explains that prepared stems stay out of rekordbox playlists.
- Fixes completed exports showing “Stopped” instead of “Ready” and restores per-track export progress.
- Improves readable, selectable interface text and keeps export states consistent across both platforms.
